summary: ESCO Technologies closed its previously announced purchase of all shares of UK-based Megger Group from Swiss seller TBG AG on October 1, 2026, under an April 15, 2026 share purchase agreement. Total consideration was about $2.3 billion: $922 million cash plus 5.10 million ESCO common shares. Terms include a post-closing net debt and working capital adjustment payable in cash. ESCO entered a shareholder agreement granting TBG one board designee while it holds its stake, and terminated the existing credit agreement in favor of a new facility. Watch closing adjustments, TBG's stake overhang, and board-governance terms.
